verdict.rationale: Firebase's core databases (Firestore, Realtime Database) are proprietary NoSQL stores accessed via SDKs, not standard SQL connection strings. Docs mention a MongoDB-compatible API for Firestore Enterprise edition (allowing existing MongoDB drivers/tools) and a 'Firebase SQL Connect' feature referenced in MCP docs, but these are niche/enterprise-only capabilities, not the default developer experience, and community feedback repeatedly cites lock-in and lack of standard tooling.
